view.name: Player
view.description: Integrated audio player with cover art, playback controls, speed and volume, and a playlist of latest episodes.

regions.label: Centered page title 'Playing Latest Episodes' and uppercase tracked text nav (Home, Episodes, Add Podcast, Player, Tags, Settings)
Square podcast artwork, time scrubber with elapsed/total, repeat/shuffle/1X speed, prev/play/next circle buttons, volume slider, now-playing title, podcast, date and description
Scrollable list of latest episodes: title (truncated), date, podcast name in bold caps, duration on right; speaker icon marks current item

evidence.note: Audio player with artwork stage, scrubber, transport and now-playing info
evidence.quote: Measles Cases Climb; Teacher Contract Talks

evidence.note: Repeat, shuffle, 1X speed, previous/play/next buttons, volume
Ordered list of latest episodes across podcasts, newest first, with current item marked by speaker icon; shuffle/repeat in player
evidence.quote: 420 - Rio Got a Parking Ticket in a Car Wash

evidence.note: Seek slider with elapsed and total time labels at either end
Volume slider with speaker icon, no labels
Top text nav across app sections
progressbar roles in ARIA are part of the seek scrubber, not separate progress UI

structure.layout: centered single-column app page: large centered H1 title, uppercase text top nav between hairline rules, then a 900px shadowed player card split into two columns — artwork + transport + now-playing info on the left, scrollable episode queue on the right

aesthetics.typography: Raleway for everything (light 300 50px H1, 11px/600 uppercase letter-spaced nav, 16px episode titles, 12–14px bold uppercase podcast names); Open Sans in a few spots; Arial on native range input
aesthetics.typeScale: Strong contrast between a single 50px light H1 and small 11–16px body; hierarchy via weight and uppercase rather than size

notes: Skeleton-CSS-style layout (Raleway, hairline rules, letter-spaced caps nav) wrapping an AmplitudeJS-style player: bright #00a0ff circular prev/play/next cluster with play button larger and overlapping, slate-gray (#607d8b) line icons for repeat/shuffle/volume and durations. Single white card with soft drop shadow, split 50/50 by a thin vertical line; right list scrolls inside the fixed-height card. Podcast artwork is a bold red diagonal-striped cover with large white caps title. Episode titles truncate with ellipsis; podcast names in bold caps under the date.
